title: Peusapat Hikmah Abadi .
intro: Sidroe tokoh nyang that geuhoreumat, nyang geuturi deungon wawasan nyang mendalam dan nasihat nyang bijaksana, tom geubri nasihat nyang meulangkah keu generasi-generasi. Kata-kata awaknyan, nyang teucatat lam kitab suci, jibimbing sidroe-droe ureueng ubak rasa syukur, saba, dan buet nyang jroh.
clues: Ulôn geubri beureukat ngon hikmah, kon keunabian.
Lon bri naseuhat keu aneuk lon keu desya nyang paleng rayeuk: meurakan ngon Allah.
Lon peurunoe teuntang brat buet, bah pih meuhareuga saboh bijeh sawi, dan pakriban Allah geupeuteubiet buet nyan.
Lon teugaih syukur keu Allah dan keu ureung chik, meungaku perjuangan bak peubeudoh sidroe aneuk.
Naseuhat ulôn nakeuh tapeudong doá, tapeurintah keuhai nyang jroh, tapeularang nyang jeuhet, dan tapeutheun deungon saba peue nyang teuka ateueh sidroe-droe ureueng.
Saboh surah lam Al-Quran geuboh nan ngon nan lon, nyang meuasoe ajaran lon dan peulajaran nyang lon bagi.

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Gobnyan geubri keukayaan nyang that rayeuk .

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
